_purpose: Ratchet for the Stage A donor-UI mirror corpora. documents/without-errors are measured by eng/cui-mirror/probe under --strict; any CUI compile error fails. A fall in `documents` means mirrors were lost and must be explained, not absorbed.
evidence_label: CUI compile evidence only. Nothing here is rendered, run natively, packaged or accepted.
_change_reason: 2026-10-31 second pass (1050 -> 1758 documents): the owner's correction that Boards' UI donor is AppFlowy, not rnote. Added the Dart/Flutter dialect, which reads widget constructor calls because AppFlowy has no markup UI, and mirrored 824 files from AppFlowy's lib plus 55 from its design-system packages (all compiling clean). Retired Boards' rnote UI mirror: 31 of its 33 documents were byte-identical to Canvas's, 2 differed, and the two donor checkouts drift in 8 UI files - one shared drawing surface must be pinned once, and the owner's single-implementation requirement forbids keeping two revisions of it. Also fixed an emitter bug that emitted space-only donor text runs as empty CUI values (CUI030, 4 documents).
